verses.text: Ha t'a b'ab'el k'uhal yik yukil uj, tze molb'ej he b'a yik tzex och ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi' malaj junok mach smunlaji. Ha jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal yik spuji k'e'en trompeta.

Tze nhusantz'a juntzanh silab' suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová: Jun nok' kelem wakax, junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi', malajokab' jab'ok spalta'il nok'.
Tzeyak'anpax ixim harina kalab'il yet' aceite tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' jun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh.

Tz'ak'jipax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun uj yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxoni, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová. Ha juntzanh chi' haton ofrenda snhusji, te suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová.
T'a slajunhil k'uhal yoch yukil uj chi', tze molb'anpax he b'a yuj eyoch ejmelal, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.

Tze nhusantz'a juntzanh silab' suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová, jun nok' kelem wakax, jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' jab'ok spalta'il nok'.
Tzeyak'anpax ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' aceite yet'ok, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' jun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul. Tzeyak'anpax silab' tz'ak'ji t'a sk'uhal yak'ji tup mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u, ixim harina yet' pax wino.
Hanheja' t'a 15 k'uhal yoch yukil uj tze molb'ej he b'a eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej. Uke' k'uhal tzeyak'och k'inh yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová.

Ha t'a junjun k'uhal k'inh chi' tze nhusantz'a juntzanh nok' nok' t'a silab'il, te suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová: Chawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 14-ok nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' jab'ok spalta'il nok'. Yet' pax ixim harina kalab'il yet' aceite tz'ak'ji ofrenda'il: Wajxake' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'. Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok t'a ofrenda'il. Ha yet' juntzanh nok' nok' chi', tzeyak'pax 13-ok nok' kelemtak wakax t'a b'ab'el k'u, 12-ok nok' t'a schab'il k'uhal, 11-ok nok' t'a yoxil k'uhal, 10-ok nok' t'a schanhil k'uhal, b'alunhwanhok nok' t'a yo'il k'uhal, wajxakwanhok nok' t'a swakil k'uhal, ukwanhok nok' t'a yukil k'uhal. Ha yet' junjun nok' kelemtak wakax chi' tz'ak'ji lajchawe'ok libra ixim harina wach', kalab'il yet' aceite. Stz'a juntzanh nok' chi' silab'il, te suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová.
Haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, tze molb'anoch he b'a eyoch ejmelal. Malaj munlajel tze k'ulej t'a jun k'uhal chi'.

Tze nhusantz'a junok nok' kelem wakax silab'il te suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi' malajokab' spalta'il nok'.
Hanhejtona' tzeyak'anpax ixim harina ofrenda'il yet' wino yet' nok' wakax chi', nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' yet' pax nok' kelemtak kalnel chi' icha yalan ley.
Tzeyak'an junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul yet' pax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' ixim harina yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok t'a ofrenda'il.

Haton juntzanh silab' tik yowalil tzeyak' t'a Jehová t'a juntzanh k'inh to chekel yaj sk'uhal. Ha yet' juntzanh tik syal eyak'anpax ofrenda to ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma junok ofrenda tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani. Syal eyak'an silab' to stz'a'i, ixim harina, ma wino t'a ofrenda'il, ma silab' yik junk'olal.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' israel masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winh.
